reference.limits: Encoding-only timing includes counter bookkeeping and profiler overhead. Whole child high-water includes startup/input loading; post-timing artifacts and candidate byte-oracle pass excluded from recorded after resources. No Core-only RSS attribution.
reference.harnessLimit: Reference encoded string remains reachable until the post-timing oracle file is written; production inline digest(canonical(...)) does not deliberately retain it after hashing. Reference profile counts UTF-8 bytes inside timing. Surviving allocation samples/end heap are not exact production liveness. Ordinary phase runs are the production RSS witness.

metricDefinitions.wall: performance.now interval, process elapsed wall; phase nesting overlaps
metricDefinitions.cpuUs: process.cpuUsage delta, all process threads, cumulative CPU over interval
metricDefinitions.allocatedBytes: V8 total_allocated_bytes delta over interval, includes GC/background allocation; not retained bytes
metricDefinitions.memory: Instantaneous process.memoryUsage samples at boundaries, bytes; heapTotal is committed V8 heap
metricDefinitions.maxRssKiB: process.resourceUsage cumulative process high-water in KiB, not subsystem-specific
metricDefinitions.external: V8 external includes ArrayBuffer accounting; counters overlap and exclude some native allocations
metricDefinitions.cpuSamples: 1ms sampling; inclusive group union prevents recursion double counting within a group; groups overlap
metricDefinitions.allocationSampling: 32768-byte interval, live sample estimates at profile end; not total allocation or native residency
metricDefinitions.stats: Exact encoded UTF-8 byte and chunk counters; bounded output strings, no complete document on qualified path

decision.reason: Exact canonical bytes, hashes, complete stable identities/outputs and recovery agree. SHA input is bounded without a complete encoded document on the production payload. Ordinary fingerprint high-water growth is lower and targeted encoding demonstrates the bounded mechanism. CPU gain is unproven; additional allocation traffic is an explicit trade-off. Integration remains one call site.
